shared_elements: repeated small strokes or rows of marks
justification: A depicts a dense field of boats with rows of crew strokes covering an open rock face, while B is an anthropomorphic figure with a head, headdress-like framing, and concentric disc and band motifs on a body; the only overlap is generic schematic outline carving with repeated small strokes and a circular element. There is no shared subject matter, no comparable relationships between motifs, and completely different compositional logic (scattered repeated vessels versus a single centred body-shaped figure).
